production_method: six built-in high-resolution overhead atmospheric district masters, downsampled into a 3840x1024 native-width strip, with deterministic ImageMagick crop, shared-boundary finishing and alpha reconstruction

chunks.role: towering storm cells and narrow updraft lanes
broken illuminated deck and broad recovery corridor
sheared storm wall and embedded lightning route
fast directional cirrus corridor with broad combat gaps
scalloped storm shelf with offset recovery pockets
broken frontal plates and diffuse under-cloud lightning

rules: Cloud districts use strict nadir composition with no horizon, wall-like canyon perspective, or repeated circular cloud towers.
Cloud districts retain readable north-south combat openings.
Every geography input is authored at final 640px runtime width or greater; builders may crop or downsample but never enlarge cloud terrain.
Native captures must preserve threat and projectile contrast after near-cloud and turbulence layers are applied.
Adjacent chunks close at zero scanline error.
Turbulence remains sparse and world-registered rather than a full-screen speed-line tile.
Orbital transition layers remain independent from cloud geography.
